title: Keyturn Guest Protection Plan: Arriving at the Difference Due on a Move of Level
content:
A guest who moves up to a protection level of higher rank than the one first held is charged the difference
between what the level moved to costs for the days of the trip still to run and the cover already paid for over
those same days, and the difference is posted against the protection fee line raised for the level first held.

The days still to run are counted from the day the move is priced to the last reserved day of the trip, the day
the move is priced included.

The difference due on a move of level is the level moved to at its daily amount for the days still to run, less
a credit at the daily amount of the level first held for those same days, and the whole is rounded to two
decimal places only once it has been worked out.

| The level | Daily amount |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0.00 USD |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 14.00 USD |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 26.00 USD |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 38.00 USD |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 52.00 USD |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 64.00 USD |

## Worked on hypothetical moves

A move priced on the tenth of a month, on a trip whose last reserved day is the nineteenth, has 10 days still
to run, the tenth counted in.

- From Keyturn Minimum Protection to Keyturn Advantage Protection: the level moved to comes to 38.00 USD for
  each of those 10 days, which is 380.00 USD, and the credit at 14.00 USD for the same 10 days is 140.00 USD,
  so the difference is 240.00 USD.
- From Keyturn Standard Protection to Keyturn Premier Protection: 52.00 USD for 10 days is 520.00 USD, less
  26.00 USD for 10 days, which is 260.00 USD, giving 260.00 USD.
- From Keyturn Declined Protection to Keyturn Business Traveler Protection: 64.00 USD for 10 days is 640.00
  USD, and the credit at 0.00 USD for those days is nothing, so the difference is 640.00 USD.

A move priced on the last reserved day of the trip itself has 1 day still to run, that day being counted in.
